name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global PMI strong in September, but October flashes and China's PMI softened
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI rose in September to its joint-highest level since 2021 (published 6 Oct). October readings so far point to softer momentum: euro-area flashes slowed (23 Oct) and China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 (31 Oct). The October global figures are due 2–4 Nov.
for_you: Global activity has held up well so far despite the energy shock.
